observation.visible_scene: A greenhouse interior with blurred rows of green tomato plants and metal support rails in the background. A young woman with long curly red hair, a black wide-brim hat, round black glasses and a white checkered top stands in the center, holding a black tablet in front of her chest with her left hand gripping it from below, and looking down at its screen.
visible_changes: Her eyes and head make small adjustments while she keeps her gaze fixed downward on the tablet, with a faint, persistent smile.
For the first part of the clip (frames 1-17) her right index finger is raised and held near the upper-left edge of the tablet, showing small hovering/tapping-like motions.
From about frame 18 onward that raised right hand is lowered out of the bottom of the frame, so only the left hand holding the tablet remains visible at the bottom.
The overall framing of the woman shifts slightly across the clip (a subtle apparent pull-back/zoom-out), while the background plant layout stays essentially the same.
outside_clip_unknowns: What content she is viewing or interacting with on the tablet.
Whether the lowered hand resumes tapping after the clip or was resting before it.
The wider greenhouse layout beyond the blurred background.
uncertain_details: Whether the raised finger performs discrete taps or merely hovers.
Whether the slight change in subject size is camera movement or the woman shifting her posture.
The exact frame at which the right hand leaves the view.
